title: Highway 82 Wildfire Candidate Replay
description: Current-event wildfire candidate replay using real Sentinel-2 L2A SWIR/NIR/Red burn-scar composites and smoke/cloud review metadata.
task_text: Review the Highway 82 wildfire near Atkinson and Waynesville, Georgia for smoke, burn scar, and vegetation stress.
summary: A real Sentinel Hub replay for the April 2026 Highway 82 fire window. The active frame is retained as smoke/cloud review evidence because SCL partially flags the white plume as cloud.

alerts.timelapse_analysis: The SWIR/NIR/Red sequence compares a March-April baseline, an April 16 ignition/pre-active window, and the April 20 active fire window. The active frame was kept even though SCL marked part of the white plume as cloud, so this remains review evidence rather than a binary fire confirmation.
alerts.analysis_summary: The replay proves the app can retain and inspect a real wildfire candidate with source-backed smoke/cloud ambiguity metadata.
alerts.satellite_note: Orbital triage retained the Highway 82 active-window frame as a smoke/cloud review candidate.
alerts.ground_note: Ground review should treat the white plume conservatively because SCL/cloud probability support is present.
alerts.ground_action: REVIEW - wildfire candidate packet is downlink-ready, but smoke/cloud ambiguity remains.
findings: The active frame is a real Sentinel Hub L2A SWIR/NIR/Red composite
The frame was retained with wildfire_smoke_cloud_review instead of being discarded as ordinary cloud
The postfire window was rejected because valid clear pixels were too low
